questions.text: Which brain region is primarily involved in regulating emotional experience and motivation?
The amygdala is most strongly associated with which function?
According to embodied cognition theories, voluntary facial muscle contraction can influence emotional experience. This idea supports which concept?
options: Emotions exist independently of bodily states
Emotion cannot occur without a conscious appraisal
Emotion is generated only through cognitive evaluation
Bodily feedback contributes to how emotions are felt
questions.correctAnswer: Bodily feedback contributes to how emotions are felt

questions.text: Higher activation in the left frontal hemisphere is generally linked to which motivational tendency?
Which emotion is commonly associated with activation of the left frontal PFC, despite being negatively valenced?
In the dimensional VAD/PAD model, dominance refers to:
options: The sense of control or submission associated with an emotion
The pleasantness of an emotional state
The intensity or energy of an emotion
The clarity with which an emotion is recognized
questions.correctAnswer: The sense of control or submission associated with an emotion

questions.text: One limitation of traditional categorical emotion models is that:
options: They struggle to represent relationships between emotions
They include too many dimensions to be practical
questions.correctAnswer: They struggle to represent relationships between emotions

questions.text: Which emotion is typically characterized by lowered eyebrows, tense eyelids, and pressed lips?
Increased skin conductance is most reliably associated with which type of disgust-related stimulus?
Crying-related sadness is associated with which physiological pattern?
options: Increased heart rate and increased skin conductance
Decreased skin conductance and reduced heart rate
No change in respiration but reduced HRV
questions.correctAnswer: Increased heart rate and increased skin conductance
